newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Jan C/A deficit widens to 22.5 bln baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai Jan C/A deficit widens to 22.5 bln baht.

text.p: Thailand's January current account deficit widened to 22.5 billion baht from 19.1 billion in December but against 28.9 billion a year ago, a finance ministry source said on Wednesday.
The senior ministry official said Thai foreign reserves fell to $38.1 billion at end-February from $39.2 billion a month earlier and $38.7 billion a year ago.

The official said broad-based Thai M-2 money supply rose a slower 9.1 percent year-on-year in February after an earlier estimated 10.9 percent growth in January and against 20.6 percent rise a year ago.
